<!--
Written for the owner, who answers from a phone and remembers how the
original PLAYED. Keep it short: the owner should be able to answer with one
number, in any language.

Only two things belong here: how the original looked, sounded or felt where
the exe reading is ambiguous, or a change to something the owner already
ruled [play]. "Follow the exe or keep ours?" is never a question: follow the
exe. A missing read is a `read` issue, not a question.

The owner answers in a comment and labels the issue `answered`. Agents post as
the owner's account, so an agent never adds `answered` itself unless the owner
dictated the answer to it. A follow-up question removes `answered`.
-->
